races.name: ABP Ports Of Grimsby & Immingham Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
GP Shipping Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Muskerry Rock
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up performer who won last time over 23f on good and has placed on this course at 26f; Harry Skelton and Dan Skelton is a potent combo in handicap hurdles, and the tongue-tie/cheekpieces combo suggests connections are serious — watch for a challenge from off the pace if the pace is genuine.

runners_data.name: Braganza Bay
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner and confirmed pace-setter, winning last time on good over 25f; Sam Twiston-Davies is an astute judge of pace and will look to use this horse's prominent style to full advantage — a 43-day break and modest trainer 14-day strike rate is the only minor query.

runners_data.name: Reforme
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with a mixed record, and a form string of 143P-P raises jumping reliability concerns; Tom Gretton has only one runner in the 14-day window and the horse has not won on going quicker than soft — the combination of trip, pace shape and jumping doubts makes this a difficult case.

runners_data.name: Cinderello
runners_data.note: In-form prominent racer with three wins from five runs on good going and an excellent course-distance profile at 26f; Jack Hogan partners a horse who has won back-to-back and gets to race in his natural position close to the lone leader — this is the horse most structurally suited to this race shape.

runners_data.name: Jungle Wood
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who holds course form at this trip and won on good at 23f; Miss Lily Bradstock claims 7lbs which alleviates the weight burden slightly, but the horse will need a stronger pace than Braganza Bay is likely to set to get home from the back — placed form here is the key positive.

runners_data.name: Klervia
runners_data.note: Recent 17-day turnaround for Fergal O'Brien suggests confidence, and the horse placed on good ground over 20f last time; however, this is a horse that naturally wants to come from off the pace and the crowded midfield will likely prevent that — OR 81 and a 3lb claim leave some margin for error.

runners_data.name: Moro Rock
runners_data.note: Experienced nine-year-old with a win over this exact course and distance on good — the most relevant piece of form in the race at face value; the 70-day absence is a concern, and as a genuine hold-up horse pressed into midfield, getting a clear run at the business end of 2m7f will be the critical factor.

runners_data.name: Matoury
runners_data.note: Has placed in decent company on good ground and Sowersby's runner carries a 42-day break; naturally wants to come from behind and the long trip should suit on breeding, but mapping to midfield rather than getting an unobstructed hold-up position makes it hard to see this horse landing a blow at its best.

runners_data.name: Time Was
runners_data.note: Philip Kirby has a quiet 14-day book and this nine-year-old's form is almost entirely on soft or heavy, making the good ground the standout concern — Miss Natasha Cookson's 7lb claim helps, but five consecutive runs on soft/heavy and now racing on good is a significant flag to manage expectations.

runners_data.name: Lady Fortune
runners_data.note: Won last time over 20f on good and trainer David Killahena & Graeme McPherson are in decent 14-day form at 3/11; a six-year-old still lightly raced and improving, but stepping up sharply from 20f to 2m7f is an unproven stamina test, and finding clear passage from a congested midfield over an unfamiliar trip is a significant ask.

races.paceDynamic: Braganza Bay is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 10-runner field and, with no genuine rivals likely to press hard from the outset over 2m7f on good ground at Market Rasen, he should be able to dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front. Behind him, Cinderello is the most natural prominent horse, and with Braganza Bay setting an uncontested tempo, the pace is unlikely to be truly searching — this creates a scenario where those travelling close to the front can conserve energy before the stamina test kicks in late. The field holds significantly more hold-up types than can realistically race at the rear in their natural roles — Moro Rock, Matoury, Klervia, Time Was and Lady Fortune are all true hold-up horses compressed into midfield positions, meaning the race shape will be congested through the middle, not strung out. This race shape — a lone front-runner setting a measured pace on good ground over a stamina trip — strongly favours horses racing prominently or just off the pace who can travel into contention fresh, rather than true closers who will need the pace to be genuinely strong to get home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Braganza Bay Dictates Alone
scenarios.trigger: If Braganza Bay leads unchallenged and sets a fair but measured gallop, controlling the tempo throughout.
scenarios.body: If Braganza Bay leads unchallenged and sets a fair but measured gallop, controlling the tempo throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Battle Home
scenarios.trigger: If Cinderello moves up to challenge Braganza Bay from the turn, injecting a real duel in the final mile.
scenarios.body: If Cinderello moves up to challenge Braganza Bay from the turn, injecting a real duel in the final mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Stayer Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If Braganza Bay sets a genuinely strong gallop that stretches the field and drains the prominent horses before the last.
scenarios.body: If Braganza Bay sets a genuinely strong gallop that stretches the field and drains the prominent horses before the last.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos From Congested Middle
scenarios.trigger: If the compressed midfield causes traffic problems and interference, leaving multiple hold-up horses blocked until too late.
scenarios.body: If the compressed midfield causes traffic problems and interference, leaving multiple hold-up horses blocked until too late.

watchPoints.text: Cinderello's prominent style gives it a structural advantage over the entire field — watch how quickly Jack Hogan positions it behind Braganza Bay from the off, as securing second or third early could be decisive.
Time Was has run all five recent starts on soft or heavy ground and is now facing good — monitor market moves and watch for any signs of discomfort in the going report or early race movement.

Moro Rock's course and distance win on good is genuinely relevant form but a 70-day absence for a nine-year-old is notable — watch whether it travels with its usual fluency or shows any ring-rustiness before the penultimate hurdle.

The compression of five hold-up horses into midfield means jumping errors or traffic problems at the hurdles in the back straight could eliminate multiple runners in one incident — watch the pace through the first mile for any bunching.

Braganza Bay's ability to set a truly sustainable gallop is the axis on which the entire race shape pivots — if he comes back to the field at any point before the home turn, the race morphs from Scenario A to something more unpredictable.

races.name: Dan Shipping Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Wings On Wheels
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner for Ian Williams with good-ground form (two seconds at 2m on Good); carries top weight of 168lbs and racing here over a slightly longer trip than recent efforts, but the uncontested lead is a significant asset — STYLE_FIT tag notes she rarely races prominently outside her front-running role so she is best assessed purely as the pacesetter.

runners_data.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners_data.note: Dan Skelton's hold-up/tracked type has the standout trainer stats in this field (T14: 14/29) and Harry Skelton aboard; won last time out over 2m1f on Good and has placed twice more in similar conditions, making him the form pick to pounce from a tracking position behind Wings On Wheels.

runners_data.name: Arctic Saint
runners_data.note: Deborah Cole runner who stays well and has placed at 2m1f on Good going most recently; off 70 days so fitness is the chief question, but his hold-up style should translate to a tracking role from which James Bowen can stalk the leader around the final circuit.

runners_data.name: Shes All Pride
runners_data.note: Sean Bowen takes the ride on this 6-year-old who has placed three times on good-ground and whose recent form shows a 3rd at 2m2f; a true hold-up horse who will likely be shuffled into mid-division rather than her natural rearward position — the best of the redistributed trio on a rating of 78, but the race shape does not set up ideally for her.

runners_data.name: Getaway Jewel
runners_data.note: Aged 12, Brian Hughes' mount has a strong good-going record (12 runs, 1 win 5 places) but almost exclusively over shorter trips of 2m; the step up to 2m3f is an untested stamina question and, as a genuine hold-up type mapped forward, she will need things to fall perfectly to land a blow at this distance.

runners_data.name: Chateau Du Lys
runners_data.note: Tom Gretton's 7-year-old (T14: 0/1) carries the minimum weight of 142lbs and an apprentice claimer in William Maggs (3); has placed three times on Good going and showed a placed effort at 2m1f last time, but as a natural hold-up horse redistibuted to a midfield berth, the modest pace is likely to blunt his late thrust.

races.paceDynamic: Wings On Wheels is the sole confirmed front-runner in this six-runner handicap chase and should lead from the outset without any genuine competition for the position, setting a controlled, sustainable gallop around Market Rasen's flat, right-handed track over 2m3f. With no rivals willing or able to pressure her up front, the pace is unlikely to be searching, and the race will likely be run at an even tempo that keeps the field relatively bunched through the early stages. Three genuine hold-up horses — Shes All Pride, Getaway Jewel, and Chateau Du Lys — are redistributed to midfield on the map because there are more hold-up types than the race shape can accommodate at the rear; in reality, Wings On Wheels is most likely to be the only horse who secures her natural berth, with Thickthorn Tom and Arctic Saint the likeliest to get close to their preferred position. This shape — a lone, uncontested leader setting a moderate pace — strongly favours horses who can track prominently without expending excess energy and then produce a clean, sustained finish, rewarding Thickthorn Tom and Arctic Saint over the true closers who may not generate enough pace to come from deep.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Wings On Wheels dictates an uncontested, moderate gallop from flag to finish without being pressured at any stage.
scenarios.body: If Wings On Wheels dictates an uncontested, moderate gallop from flag to finish without being pressured at any stage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tracker Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If a horse tracking in second or third conserves energy perfectly and produces a strong run from the second-last fence.
scenarios.body: If a horse tracking in second or third conserves energy perfectly and produces a strong run from the second-last fence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers Rattle Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves genuinely modest and the hold-up horses find enough clear air to make sustained late progress.
scenarios.body: If the pace proves genuinely modest and the hold-up horses find enough clear air to make sustained late progress.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Wings On Wheels, left completely alone, sets a slow enough pace that she conserves energy and outstays her rivals up the run-in.
scenarios.body: If Wings On Wheels, left completely alone, sets a slow enough pace that she conserves energy and outstays her rivals up the run-in.

watchPoints.text: Watch whether any of Shes All Pride, Getaway Jewel or Chateau Du Lys attempt to push forward at the start — if two or more crowd the early pace, Wings On Wheels' uncontested lead evaporates and the entire pace dynamic changes.

Monitor Thickthorn Tom's jumping in the early stages; Harry Skelton will want to sit second or third from the outset, but if he is slow away or makes an error, the Skelton pair could find themselves trapped further back than ideal in a small, slowly-run field.

Arctic Saint's 70-day absence is the key fitness flag — James Bowen may need to drop him in conservatively, but in a moderate-paced race over 2m3f a horse short of peak fitness can be exposed at the business end of the final circuit.

Wings On Wheels' rider Charlie Todd is riding for a small trainer (T14: 1/49) — note whether she is allowed to idle in front, as Market Rasen's relatively flat finish can catch a front-runner out if rivals are travelling strongly two out.
Getaway Jewel is 12 years old tackling 2m3f for the first time on this evidence — watch for any signs of her weakening after the second-last if stamina at this trip has not been proven.

races.name: Global Shipping Services Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Hello Sweety
runners_data.note: Stuart Edmunds in 1/3 form over the past 14 days and this 5yo has winning form at 2m+ on good ground — two recent wins at 2m on soft show she handles worse, and 19 days since her last run is a fresh, ready profile; she will try to position herself just off the pace rather than bury herself at the rear.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: Six consecutive wins including six from six on good ground makes this 7yo's record exceptional, and Dan Skelton's yard is firing (14/29 in 14 days) — the lone confirmed front-runner who can set his own terms, though the [STYLE_FIT=0.93] flag signals he may be racing slightly outside his optimum role if asked to press rather than lead; here he simply leads, which suits him perfectly.

runners_data.name: The Secret Pearl
runners_data.note: Alex Hales has a quiet 14-day record (0/5) and this 7yo's recent form reads 2254-6 with the best efforts coming on good or soft going at 2m+ — she is a genuine hold-up horse by profile with tongue-tie headgear, and her two placed efforts on good ground suggest she is in the mix for minor honours if the closers get a run.

runners_data.name: Miracles Do Happen
runners_data.note: Billy Aprahamian lands 1/1 in the past fortnight and this 5yo's most recent win came at 2m on good ground — a true deep closer by nature, her position on the map is a function of the field's density of hold-up types rather than her preferred racing style, and the [STYLE_FIT=0.91] flag means her effectiveness here depends on whether she can fire from further back than ideal.

runners_data.name: Assorda
runners_data.note: John Wainwright is 3/8 in the past 14 days and this 6yo runs in a tongue-tie, but recent form of P66-56 on good ground is uninspiring — she races from the back by instinct, and the map shows her further forward than she will actually want to be, meaning the [STYLE_FIT=0.92] tag correctly flags a horse who may struggle to express her natural style in this crowded hold-up division.

runners_data.name: Kottayam
runners_data.note: Dave Roberts has just 0/1 in the past 14 days and this 6yo has missed the frame in four of her last five, including two pulled-up runs — her best effort (2nd at 2m4f on good) came from hold-up tactics, but 58 days off and a declining form string make her hard to fancy even in a wide-open scenario; tongue-tie noted.

runners_data.name: Miss Friday Lions
runners_data.note: Rebecca Menzies sends this 5yo in for a second consecutive good-ground start, and her 3rd at 2m on good last time is her most encouraging recent effort — she is a born hold-up horse (hood worn) and her redistribution to midfield on the map simply reflects the overcrowding at the rear, not any natural inclination to race prominently.

runners_data.name: Little Soiree
runners_data.note: Olly Williams is 0/3 over 14 days and this 8yo's form of 0P6-P6 paints a bleak picture — two non-completions in recent starts, and though a 3lb claimer William Maggs(3) takes the ride to trim the weight burden, the horse needs things to go dramatically wrong for the leaders to enter contention from her inevitable rearward position.

races.paceDynamic: Beorma is the sole confirmed front-runner in this eight-runner field and, with no genuine challenger for the lead, Harry Skelton will be able to dictate an unhurried, controlled tempo on good ground over 2m½f at Market Rasen — the kind of moderate, sustainable gallop that keeps the race together deep into the back straight before the pace lifts from three out. The remaining seven runners are all hold-up types by profile, but Hello Sweety, The Secret Pearl, and Miracles Do Happen have the class and going form to travel prominently enough to poach a position just off the pace, while Assorda, Kottayam, Miss Friday Lions, and Little Soiree are true deep closers who will be forced into midfield rather than their natural rearward berth. This field holds more genuine hold-up horses than can all settle in their preferred position — Beorma will almost certainly secure the front, and Hello Sweety (proven front-foot winner in similar conditions) is the likeliest to press into a handy second or third slot, with Miracles Do Happen and The Secret Pearl the others most capable of travelling just off the leader. A controlled, single-paced gallop on good ground at a tight, undulating track that rewards horses travelling well and jumping fluently throughout favours the horse sitting just off the leader in a prominent handy position — front-to-near-front types who can quicken from two out hold the strongest positional advantage in this shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Beorma Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Beorma is allowed to bowl along in front at his own rhythm with no pressure applied and the field strings out behind from halfway.
scenarios.body: If Beorma is allowed to bowl along in front at his own rhythm with no pressure applied and the field strings out behind from halfway.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hello Sweety Tracks And Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Hello Sweety travels smoothly in second or third and produces her characteristic late surge from a handy position when Beorma's gallop finally flattens out.
scenarios.body: If Hello Sweety travels smoothly in second or third and produces her characteristic late surge from a handy position when Beorma's gallop finally flattens out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers Grind Through Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves deceptively taxing on the good ground and the leaders tire sharply from two out, giving the deeper hold-up horses a run through.
scenarios.body: If the pace proves deceptively taxing on the good ground and the leaders tire sharply from two out, giving the deeper hold-up horses a run through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Aids Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If Beorma makes an uncharacteristic mistake or the pace fragments dramatically, creating a lottery in the straight that opens the race to lower-rated hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: If Beorma makes an uncharacteristic mistake or the pace fragments dramatically, creating a lottery in the straight that opens the race to lower-rated hold-up horses.

watchPoints.text: Beorma — if Harry Skelton is allowed to slide into an uncontested lead from the off, the six-timer is operating in his ideal race shape and any slow early tempo will make him very hard to run down from two out.

Hello Sweety — watch where Charlie Hammond positions her in the first half-mile; if she gets the second or third slot off Beorma's back she becomes the primary danger, but if she is squeezed back into the hold-up pack her effectiveness is reduced.

Miracles Do Happen — Gavin Sheehan on a horse whose true style is deep hold-up but who will likely be forced into midfield by the field density; if she gets a clean run up the inner at the second-last she could emerge late, making her a live in-running threat at a price.

The Secret Pearl — Kielan Woods will look to exploit the steady pace from a patient handy position; her 2m+ going form is respectable and she could fill a place if the two market leaders above her make errors at the final hurdle.
Kottayam — 58 days off and two recent non-completions make her a market watch; any significant market move would be notable given the trainer's quiet recent record.

races.name: Associated British Ports "Summer Plate Trial" Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mahons Glory
runners_data.note: Trained by Dylan Cunha and ridden by Lee Edwards, this 10-year-old has strong Good-ground credentials (9/15 similar going) and takes a prominent role naturally; his style fit of 0.93 flags a marginal positional stretch but as the sole confirmed front-runner with 55 days' rest he is well-placed to control tempo on his terms.

runners_data.name: Bhaloo
runners_data.note: Nicky Henderson's eight-year-old carries 162lbs and has placed twice on Good ground in recent history including a second over 24f; a naturally prominent runner who should travel smoothly just behind Mahons Glory, he holds course-related form and has the class profile to challenge late if the front-runner weakens.

runners_data.name: Genois
runners_data.note: Harry Cobden takes the ride on this Jonjo & A J O'Neill-trained ten-year-old who has been prolific in placed finishes (four of five recent runs) and won at 20f on Soft; 35 days since his last run is fresh enough, and he sits comfortably just off the pace as a prominent type, with the experience to strike on Good ground if conditions suit.

runners_data.name: Bleu d'Enfer
runners_data.note: The only genuine hold-up runner in the race, Donald McCain's eight-year-old has two recent placed efforts on Good ground at 2m and wears a tongue-tie/pull-through combo suggesting he needs to be ridden quietly into the race; a sustainable pace may not generate enough late momentum, but a truly run race would bring him into play from the rear.

runners_data.name: Seaview Rock
runners_data.note: Won fresh (17 days since last run) and has placed twice on Good ground, but his natural front-running tendency cannot be accommodated cleanly — there are simply too many prominent types ahead of him in this field shape, and he may have to race further back than ideal, which the 0.93 style-fit flag reinforces.

runners_data.name: Gateau De Miel
runners_data.note: Fergal O'Brien's ten-year-old won over 21f on Good ground last time and holds a strong similar-going record (10/15), making him the most in-form of those mapped away from their preferred prominent position; wearing a tongue tie and despite being squeezed out of the front rank, his recent winning form gives him legitimate claims if he can find a clear run.

runners_data.name: Ostend
runners_data.note: Mickey Bowen's eight-year-old boasts an active trainer form (5 winners from 18 over 14 days) and Shane Fenelon claims 5lb, but 69 days off and a history of question-mark finishes on Soft suggest he needs things to fall his way; naturally prominent, he is pushed rearward by a crowded front rank and will need the race to unfold in an unusually chaotic fashion to get involved.

races.paceDynamic: Mahons Glory is the lone confirmed front-runner in this seven-runner field and, with no genuine rival looking to press him from the outset, he is likely to dictate at a measured, controlled tempo on Good ground at Market Rasen. Bhaloo, Genois, and the three redistributed types — Seaview Rock, Gateau De Miel, and Ostend — are all naturally prominent horses, but the race shape can only accommodate one or two at the front, meaning several will be forced to race in a more restrained position than they would choose. Bleu d'Enfer, as the sole genuine hold-up horse, is the only runner whose natural style maps cleanly to the rear of this field. The sustainable, uncontested gallop set by Mahons Glory strongly favours horses with tactical versatility that can travel comfortably off the pace before asserting — prominent types forced into midfield and genuine hold-up runners benefit most, while Mahons Glory's rider Lee Edwards can control the race and preserve energy through the first half before the contest intensifies at the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mahons Glory Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Mahons Glory is allowed to bowl along in front at his own rhythm with no rival willing or able to put him under pressure.
scenarios.body: If Mahons Glory is allowed to bowl along in front at his own rhythm with no rival willing or able to put him under pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Grind Him Down
scenarios.trigger: If two or more of the redistributed prominent horses — Seaview Rock, Gateau De Miel, or Genois — push forward early and force a contested pace, applying sustained pressure to Mahons Glory.
scenarios.body: If two or more of the redistributed prominent horses — Seaview Rock, Gateau De Miel, or Genois — push forward early and force a contested pace, applying sustained pressure to Mahons Glory.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong enough to string the field out and Bleu d'Enfer, the only true hold-up runner, gets a strong gallop to aim at from the back.
scenarios.body: If the pace is genuinely strong enough to string the field out and Bleu d'Enfer, the only true hold-up runner, gets a strong gallop to aim at from the back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalise In Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If erratic jumping or interference scrambles the race order mid-contest and those pushed out of their natural roles — Ostend, Gateau De Miel — find a rhythm late.
scenarios.body: If erratic jumping or interference scrambles the race order mid-contest and those pushed out of their natural roles — Ostend, Gateau De Miel — find a rhythm late.

watchPoints.text: Mahons Glory holds a clear positional monopoly at the front — watch whether Lee Edwards uses this to dictate a truly leisurely tempo that could see him preserve enough for a devastating last-fence jump.

Seaview Rock, Gateau De Miel, and Ostend are all natural front-runners who cannot all get their desired position — monitor early strides for any of the three attempting to push forward and create an unplanned contested pace.

Bleu d'Enfer needs a strong gallop to fire from the rear; if Mahons Glory is allowed to go at a crawl, Theo Gillard may face an impossible task from the back and the horse's hold-up profile becomes redundant.

Gateau De Miel's Good-ground win over 21f just 20 days ago is the freshest winning form in the field — watch whether Tom Broughton (3lb claim) pushes him forward to reclaim a prominent berth rather than accepting midfield.

Bhaloo has two pulled-up finishes in his recent form string — monitor his jumping from the outset, as any error under top weight (162lbs) could undermine what looks like a sound tactical position just off the leader.

races.name: ABP Ports Of Hull & Goole Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Tuba
runners_data.note: Three wins from her last four starts including two at Stratford and one at Goodwood on Good; front-running role here suits perfectly and jockey Fern O'Brien (5) keeps the weight competitive, but the STYLE_FIT tag is for the Prominent label — she is actually the race's natural leader and her chance should be assessed on that basis.

runners_data.name: Vivid Pink
runners_data.note: 229-day absence is the key concern, but Alan King's yard is in form (3/11 over 14 days) and she has winning form on Good over 2m; her prominent style suits this controlled shape well and Tom Bellamy is a strong booking.

runners_data.name: Lone Star
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer with placed form at 2m5f on Good ground, and trainer Philip Kirby has had a quiet 14-day spell (0/14); the step up in trip here suits his patient style but he needs the pace to lift from the home turn.

runners_data.name: Midnight Pass
runners_data.note: Consistent without winning — eight runs on Good and never outside the first four — and Emma Lavelle's in-form yard (2/6) is encouraging; a prominent runner who should get a good position behind Tuba, though finishing off a 2m4½f trip is yet to be proven.

runners_data.name: Gms Prince
runners_data.note: Veteran of 11 years and usually prominent, with a recent second at 2m on Good at the top of his form figures; trainer Sarah Hollinshead has only had one runner in 14 days (0/1) and the 75-day break needs to be respected, but course-trip familiarity counts.

runners_data.name: Bunker Bay
runners_data.note: Two wins in his last two starts at 2m on Good and 2m on Good, making him one of the most in-form horses in the field; genuine hold-up type who will need the pace to be honest, and jockey Joshua Thompson (5) is an apprentice claim that softens his weight burden.

runners_data.name: Mancero
runners_data.note: Won his most recent start at 2m on Good for David Pipe with Jack Tudor aboard — a strong combination; prominent style suits the anticipated race shape and his four runs in this trip range suggest he handles it well, though Pipe's 14-day stats (0/9) temper enthusiasm.

runners_data.name: Red Trail
runners_data.note: Modest form figures and no wins recorded in his last five runs on Good going; hold-up type who requires plenty to go right, and the three-pound claimer Charlie Maggs helps the cause but the overall profile suggests a minor role at best.

runners_data.name: Onehundredneighty
runners_data.note: Ben Pauling is in reasonable form (2/10) and this horse placed twice from eight runs on Good; a true hold-up runner naturally suited to coming late, he is pushed into a midfield mapping by overcrowding at the rear — his finishing kick may be blunted if he cannot settle as far back as he wants.

runners_data.name: Earlofbrackenstown
runners_data.note: A record full of pulls-up and finishes well down the field, and flagged as fading in the finish; in his natural hold-up role he would need everything to go right, but forced into a more prominent position by the pace map, his profile looks weak from every angle.

runners_data.name: Bargain Hunter
runners_data.note: 93 days off the track and a form string of 57890- says everything — no wins, fading finishes, and flagged for tiring late; a genuine hold-up type who has been redistributed to midfield in the map, and the long layoff adds further doubt about fitness and readiness.

runners_data.name: Ikigai Star
runners_data.note: Listed as a non-runner; no further assessment applicable.

races.paceDynamic: Tuba is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 12-runner handicap hurdle over 2m4½f on Good ground at Market Rasen, and with no genuine challenger for the lead, she is set to dictate an uncontested, sustainable gallop throughout. Vivid Pink, Midnight Pass, Gms Prince, and Mancero will likely slot in behind her as the prominent group, creating a controlled race shape that rewards those travelling smoothly in the first half. The field holds more hold-up horses than can realistically settle at the rear — Onehundredneighty, Earlofbrackenstown, and Bargain Hunter are true hold-up types but are mapped to midfield due to overcrowding at the back, meaning they are unlikely to get their natural position and their finishing kicks may be compromised. With one horse controlling a steady pace on a track that suits front-runners, this race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can travel close to Tuba and kick from two out, with hold-up horses facing a stiffer task than usual against an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tuba Controls, Prominent Win
scenarios.trigger: If Tuba dictates an uncontested, measured gallop and the prominent group tracks her to the last with energy in reserve.
scenarios.body: If Tuba dictates an uncontested, measured gallop and the prominent group tracks her to the last with energy in reserve.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tuba Makes All Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so untroubled that Tuba simply extends her lead from the second-last and none of the prominent horses can accelerate past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swoop Late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group over-races chasing Tuba and the pace lifts sufficiently mid-race to string the field out.

scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Midfield Surge

watchPoints.text: Bunker Bay has won his last two starts on Good ground and at shorter trips — watch whether jockey Joshua Thompson (5) can get him into a forward enough position from his hold-up base to challenge the leaders from the last hurdle.

Vivid Pink's 229-day absence is the biggest question in the race — watch her in the paddock and early in the race for signs of rustiness; if she travels sweetly, Alan King's prep record suggests she may be primed.

Tuba's three recent wins make her the key pace influence — if she is allowed to stride clear unchallenged after the second-last, prominent rivals like Mancero and Midnight Pass must respond immediately or risk being left for dead.

Onehundredneighty, Earlofbrackenstown, and Bargain Hunter are all true hold-up types forced wider in the pack — watch for traffic problems in the straight if the field fans out, particularly with 12 runners over the final two flights.

Red Trail drops significantly in class and trip on his historic form figures — watch his early position to see whether jockey Charlie Maggs (3) attempts to employ a more aggressive tactic than the hold-up profile suggests.
